project.name: Larkspur - HR desk
project.description: Larkspur Freight (fictional): the people handbook, the HR desk's past decisions and the CPO office's exception register. memorylake-usecases demo.

records.text: People handbook section 4.2, working from abroad: an employee may work from another country for up to 4 weeks (20 working days) a year, approved by their manager and HR. Longer stays need a written exception from the CPO (tax and visa exposure).
People handbook section 6.1, holiday carry-over: up to 5 unused holiday days carry over into the next year and must be taken by March 31. Carrying over more needs a written exception from the CPO.
People handbook section 7.3, bereavement leave: 5 paid days for a partner, child or parent; 3 paid days for a grandparent, sibling or in-law. Longer leave needs a written exception from the CPO.
People handbook section 9.1, home-office stipend: a one-time stipend of up to 400 dollars for home-office equipment, paid on receipts. Anything above needs a written exception from the CPO.
